profileEvidence.author: B
profileEvidence.summary: Water Spaniels bring different characters to a water-working heritage. The Irish Water Spaniel is loyal, alert and playful, with a sense of humour and some reserve toward strangers. The American Water Spaniel is friendly and eager to please, yet energetic in the hunt. Both retrieve game from water; the American was developed to work from small boats as well as on land.
profileEvidence.shortDescription: Water-working spaniels include the playful, loyal Irish breed and the eager American hunter, each with its own character.
